purpose: Deterministically characterize held-out cohort scale and crowding without using model predictions.

definitions.median_relative_area: median of bbox_area / image_area over all ground-truth instances
definitions.small_instance_fraction: fraction of ground-truth boxes with absolute area below 32^2 pixels
definitions.images_with_small_fraction: fraction of images containing at least one COCO-small ground-truth box
definitions.overlap_image_fraction_iou_gt_0.1: fraction of images containing at least one ground-truth pair with IoU greater than 0.1

interpretation_boundary: COCO small is an absolute pixel-area definition; AP_S and small fractions are interpreted within each dataset, while relative-area distributions describe cross-dataset scale shift.
